name: Rotten Eggs
label: Quest
description: Rotten Eggs: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The humans of Southshore love their ale, and as such they prize the ale served at the Southshore Inn. With the chaos of Hallow's End now upon them, we can use it to ruin their latest batch of beverages for weeks - if not months to come!
Take these rotten eggs and place them in the main brew keg inside the Southshore Inn. Your presence alone will cause strife, so be prepared to defend yourself!
Once you've given Southshore a taste they'll not soon forget, return to me here at the festival!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The keg is filled with ale.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Having successfully fought your way inside the inn, you now place the eggs inside the keg. You can smell the foul odor permeating the air...
